analyst_view.overall: Early view: with a month to go, KuPS (33rd, one point) host CSKA Sofia (28th, one point) on matchday 5, at the Tammela stadium in Tampere, where KuPS also played Gent. Both are near the bottom and both will likely need a win to keep any hope of the play-offs. CSKA have been competitive in narrow defeats; KuPS have scored twice in three games.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.5 goals. I lean a little higher: all three of CSKA's games have had at least three goals, and KuPS conceded four at home to Trabzonspor. Two sides needing to win should open the game up.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.5 corners. Nothing I read moves this.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.3 cards. No referee is known and neither side has a disciplinary pattern in this competition.

shots.text: The numbers say 29.0 shots, more for CSKA. That fits CSKA's attacking games so far; I stay with it.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 9.7 shots on target. Nothing points clearly away from it this far out.
